overview: A modern Arabic RTL streaming app for short dramas and short movies, with browsing, search, favorites, ratings, continue-watching, and an admin dashboard.
features: Browse featured short dramas and movies on a mobile-first home page
Search and filter content by category and type
Open a title to see its cover, description, rating, and episode list
Watch episodes in a built-in video player with next/previous navigation
Save favorites and resume watching from where you left off
Switch between dark and light mode
Sign in to keep favorites, ratings, and progress per user
Admin dashboard to add, edit, and delete titles and episodes
Sample Arabic content ready to explore
